correctness.rationale: For all real |a+2|, |b-3/2| <= 10^-3 the piecewise planar map is continuous at x=0. Direct substitution gives one-step section return ax-1 and three-step LRL return a(1+(a-1)b)x-[1+(a-1)b]-a-1. Rational interval bounds ensure inverse branches phi_0,phi_1 map I=[-9/10,-1/100] strictly into disjoint subintervals and LRL intermediate x signs +,- and negative y at the second phase. The unique address on the separated IFS produces a conjugate renewal three-state shift with transitions 0→0/1, 1→2,2→0; rho(A) solves lambda^3-lambda^2-1=0. Strong separation and bi-Lipschitz affine phases yield dimension root |a|^-d+|a[1+(a-1)b]|^-d=1. Only the explicitly constructed compact subsystem, not the full attractor, is proved to have these invariants.
